/** Runs only after copying into a fresh generated, installed package consumer. */
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { mkdtemp, rm } from "node:fs/promises";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { defineFactory as defineRootFactory, Factory as RootFactory } from "@getstrata/core";
import { BaseRepository } from "@getstrata/core/database/baseRepository";
import { createDatabaseBindings } from "@getstrata/core/database/bindings";
import { defineModel, defineRepository } from "@getstrata/core/database/definitions";
import { defineFactory, Factory } from "@getstrata/core/database/factory";
import { Model } from "@getstrata/core/database/model";
import type { DatabaseSession, TransactionSession } from "@getstrata/core/database/session";
import { defineTable } from "@getstrata/core/database/table";
import { DATABASE_SESSION_TOKEN } from "@getstrata/core/database/tokens";
import { createApplication } from "@getstrata/core/runtime/application";
import { createWidgetFactory, WidgetFactory } from "../modules/widget/factory.ts";
import type { WidgetRecord } from "../modules/widget/types.ts";

assert.equal(RootFactory, Factory);
assert.equal(defineRootFactory, defineFactory);
const complete = (): WidgetRecord => ({ id: 0, name: "complete", parent_id: null });
assert.deepEqual(RootFactory.from(WidgetFactory, { definition: complete }).make(), complete());
const rootDefinition = defineRootFactory({ construct: () => ({ definition: complete }) });
assert.deepEqual(Factory.from(rootDefinition).make(), complete());
const pure = createWidgetFactory({ definition: complete });
assert.deepEqual(pure.make(), complete());
await assert.rejects(
  () => pure.create(),
  /WidgetFactory persistence must be supplied to use create/,
);

// These are compiled by the generated app's actual check, never invoked.
export function generatedFactoryTypeContracts() {
  // @ts-expect-error the shipped helper requires explicit dependencies
  createWidgetFactory();
  // @ts-expect-error the shipped helper requires a complete definition callback
  createWidgetFactory({});
  // @ts-expect-error generated definition returns every required field
  createWidgetFactory({ definition: () => ({ id: 0 }) });
  createWidgetFactory({
    definition: complete,
    // @ts-expect-error persistence returns complete records
    persist: async () => ({ id: 1 }),
  });
  // @ts-expect-error afterMaking is synchronous
  pure.afterMaking(async (record) => {
    record.name = "async";
  });
  const rows: WidgetRecord[] = pure.count(1).make();
  return rows;
}

const table = defineTable<WidgetRecord, "id">({
  name: "factory_rows",
  primaryKey: "id",
  columns: ["id", "name", "parent_id"],
});
const repository = defineRepository({
  name: "generated-factory",
  table,
  dependencies: [],
  create: (binding) => new BaseRepository(binding),
});
class Entity extends Model<WidgetRecord, "id"> {}
const model = defineModel({
  name: "GeneratedFactoryEntity",
  repository,
  dependencies: [],
  attributes: { timestamps: false, fillable: ["name", "parent_id"] },
  construct: (state, binding) => new Entity(state, binding),
});
const selected = (session: DatabaseSession | TransactionSession) => {
  const bound = session.model(model);
  // Actual emitted helper is used for every selected parent/child write.
  return createWidgetFactory({
    definition: complete,
    persist: async (values) => (await bound.create(values)).toObject(),
  });
};
const directory = await mkdtemp(join(process.cwd(), ".factory-proof-"));
const application = (name: string) =>
  createApplication({
    providers: [],
    services: createDatabaseBindings({
      default: "main",
      connections: { main: { driver: "sqlite", filename: join(directory, `${name}.sqlite`) } },
      repositories: [repository],
      models: [model],
    }),
  });
const a = application("a"),
  b = application("b");
const applications = [a, b];
const run = <T>(app: typeof a, work: (db: DatabaseSession) => T | Promise<T>) =>
  app.run((scope) => work(scope.resolve(DATABASE_SESSION_TOKEN)));
const names = (app: typeof a) =>
  run(app, (db) =>
    db.execute<{ name: string }>({ text: "SELECT name FROM factory_rows ORDER BY id", params: [] }),
  );
let oldScope!: Factory<WidgetRecord>,
  oldTransaction!: Factory<WidgetRecord>,
  oldOwner!: Factory<WidgetRecord>;
const scopeExpired = { code: "APPLICATION_SCOPE_EXPIRED" };
const errors: unknown[] = [];
let ownersClosed = true;
try {
  for (const app of applications) {
    await app.start();
    await run(app, (db) =>
      db.execute({
        text: "CREATE TABLE factory_rows (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, parent_id INTEGER)",
        params: [],
      }),
    );
  }
  await run(a, async (db) => {
    oldScope = selected(db);
    await oldScope
      .has(selected(db).state({ name: "a-child" }), "parent_id")
      .create({ name: "a-parent" });
  });
  await run(b, (db) => selected(db).create({ name: "b-only" }));
  assert.deepEqual(
    (await names(a)).map((row) => row.name),
    ["a-parent", "a-child"],
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    (await names(b)).map((row) => row.name),
    ["b-only"],
  );
  await assert.rejects(() => oldScope.create({ name: "expired-invocation" }), scopeExpired);
  const rollback = new Error("generated-factory-rollback");
  let callbackDone = false;
  await run(a, async (db) => {
    await assert.rejects(
      () =>
        db.transaction(async (tx) => {
          oldTransaction = selected(tx);
          await oldTransaction
            .has(selected(tx).state({ name: "rollback-child" }), "parent_id")
            .afterCreating(async () => {
              await Bun.sleep(0);
              callbackDone = true;
            })
            .create({ name: "rollback-parent" });
          assert.equal(callbackDone, true, "Factory create must await the selected callback");
          throw rollback;
        }),
      (error) => error === rollback,
    );
    await assert.rejects(() => oldTransaction.create({ name: "expired-transaction" }), {
      name: "PersistenceError",
      code: "DATABASE_TRANSACTION_SCOPE",
    });
    oldOwner = selected(db);
  });
  assert.deepEqual(
    (await names(a)).map((row) => row.name),
    ["a-parent", "a-child"],
    "Selected transaction rolls parent and child back",
  );
  assert.equal((await a.stop()).successful, true);
  await assert.rejects(() => oldOwner.create({ name: "expired-owner" }), scopeExpired);
  assert.deepEqual(
    (await names(b)).map((row) => row.name),
    ["b-only"],
    "Expired A capabilities never fall back to B",
  );
} catch (error) {
  errors.push(error);
} finally {
  for (const app of applications) {
    try {
      const result = await app.stop();
      if (!result.successful) {
        ownersClosed = false;
        errors.push(
          new AggregateError(
            result.snapshot.errors.map((diagnostic) => diagnostic.error),
            "Generated Factory application cleanup incomplete",
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      ownersClosed = false;
      errors.push(error);
    }
  }
  if (ownersClosed) {
    try {
      await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
    } catch (error) {
      errors.push(error);
    }
  } else console.error("Retained generated Factory resources", directory);
}
if (errors.length === 1) throw errors[0];
if (errors.length) throw new AggregateError(errors, "Generated Factory proof and cleanup failed");
console.log(
  "PASS generated Factory scaffold, public identity and selected SQLite owner/transaction/expiry",
);
